spoken.Q5_INTRO: Imagine that a marketing firm is doing research in your area. You have agreed to participate in a telephone interview about vending machines, which are machines that sell snacks and other products.
spoken.Q5: How often do you make purchases at vending machines, and when was the last time you used one?
